suggestion: Publish this site as the decision surface, not a dashboard of numbers
problem_it_solves: There is no shared place to compare options before changes are made; decisions are being made in prose.
evidence: The owner explicitly asked for a suggestions section to review and choose a path first.
status: Done — pages/suggestions.html carries the review states.

suggestion: Treat every number as sourced-or-blank; never interpolate
problem_it_solves: An unsourced number is indistinguishable from a hallucination once it is on a page.
evidence: The owner's verification requirement; implemented as the blank+flag rule.
status: Done — 209 injury rows and 30 clubs' depth fields are blank and flagged.

suggestion: Make 'unverified' a first-class status with its own page
Ship the cross-sectional correlation work now, and label clearly what it cannot answer
problem_it_solves: Correlation was requested but only team-level data exists; publishing it silently would overclaim.
evidence: Measured r=0.926 for EPA/play vs PPG but only r=0.023 for rush Y/A vs PPG.
status: Done — pages/correlation.html with CI columns and a scope warning.

suggestion: Buy a licensed historical odds archive before writing any bet logic
problem_it_solves: Gates G3, G4, G5, G9 are all unpassable without it. Every strategy is blocked at the same gate.
evidence: 12 of 12 strategies are blocked or unproven; the blocking gate for 9 of them is G3.
status: This is the single highest-leverage spend. Recommended first action.

suggestion: Ingest player-level game logs to unlock prop and parlay work
problem_it_solves: Player props and correlated parlays are explicitly in scope but have zero data behind them.
evidence: ST07/ST08 blocked at G1 and G7.
status: Needed for the parlay half of the brief.

suggestion: Pre-register the strategy registry before any backtest runs
problem_it_solves: An unbounded registry makes G10 unenforceable and lets luck win the leaderboard.
evidence: Computed: 25.1% chance a single zero-edge strategy shows >=55% over 200 bets.
status: Cheapest possible fix for the biggest governance hole.

suggestion: Set a hard sample floor before a strategy can be ranked
evidence: Computed: 2,243 bets needed to detect a true 55% rate at 80% power.

suggestion: Automate per-club depth-chart capture for all 32 clubs
problem_it_solves: Depth-string deficiency is a core requirement but is covered for only 2 clubs.
evidence: nfl.com/teams/{club}/depthchart returns 404 (S17); club sites publish depth charts individually.
status: 30 club pages to capture; each is structured and scrapeable.

suggestion: Calibrate injury-designation weights against realised snap counts
problem_it_solves: The proposed weights (Out 1.00 / Doubtful 0.75 / Questionable 0.40) are guesses.
evidence: Official policy defines the labels but publishes no predictive value for them.
status: Do not present the weights as measured until calibrated.

problem_it_solves: Rejected ideas get rebuilt by the next session.
evidence: ST06 was killed by our own data; without a record it will return.
status: Done — rejected strategies are on the strategies page with the reason.

suggestion: Add a changelog and a data-retrieval timestamp to every page
problem_it_solves: Without timestamps a stale page looks current.
evidence: Every dataset was captured 2026-11-14; the season is live.
status: Done — footer stamps on all pages.

suggestion: Do not build an automated bettor yet
problem_it_solves: Auto-betting before any gate passes converts modelling error into money loss, and raises licensing questions.
status: Publish lines; do not stake them.

suggestion: Decide the primary deliverable before expanding scope
problem_it_solves: Research artefact vs product vs syndicate pull in different directions.
status: Recommended: research artefact that publishes originated lines.

suggestion: Version the injury snapshot daily during the season
problem_it_solves: A Week 10 snapshot decays hourly once practice reports change.
evidence: Official practice reports file on a fixed weekly schedule (S10).
status: Pipeline exists in tools/; needs a scheduler, which needs a host.
